Generalized the agent mechanism; now 1 lombok.jar can serve as the agent for BOTH netbeans AND eclipse, and is future-ready for an IntelliJ agent.

beta 2.
Fix for actually using tools.jar properly.
--help now no longer prints errors.
Added documentation for delombok.
Delombok now auto-discovers and uses tools.jar from your java installation.
Added documentation to LombokApp.
The delombok task now works!
Fix on the previous commit involving the compile build script: delombok is now actually compiled. heh.
SPI-ified the 'app' concept, which lets us create little apps inside lombok.jar proper. Currently used only by 'delombok'.
Whoops, eclipse dependency on com.zwitserloot.cmdreader wasn't set up correctly.

Solved the problem in the two-phase compile (some of lombok is JVM1.5, other bits are JVM1.6) being interdependent and causing implicit compilation warnings.

Also added source="1.x" to all ant file javac targets, as apparently this needs to be there when compiling with JDK7.
Updated changelog with the good news on issue #61 (now works on JDK7)
Preliminary version of the delombok ant task.

This is a patch submitted by lahoda on the issue tracker (issue #61). It apparently makes lombok work on JDK7.

Will need to verify it, but, awesome sleuthing work by lahoda!
Pretty crucial bugfix that stopped all lombok annotations on types from working with javac. Whoops.
Post-beta deploy
Building a  beta for deployment.
delombok is now part of the master branch!
Merge branch 'delombok'

Delombok now works from the command line as:

java -jar lombok.jar delombok (args)
Added delombok to the build scripts.
Added cmdreader dependency, as delombok uses it to have a nice command line.
Fixed whitespace to project standards.

Added a class that is easier to use than the parser itself for delombok, as well as code to process entire directories at a time.
Also removed duplication from the testcases.

Thorough work on inserting comments in the proper place for delombok; should now work fine with GWT native methods!

NON-NLS-1 is still theoretically problematic, but that'll be a fix for another day.

Also added ability to recognize that nothing has changed, which will copy the original file instead of reparsing it.
Added change tracking so that 1 AST instance can tell you if any processor changed anything.
Added another test
We encountered a strange NPE here. Can't reproduce, nevertheless added null-checks
delombok now calls lombok. wahey!
Minor refactoring + added testcase for for-loop
Major restructuring+adding tests
Solved or suppressed warnings
Work in progress on delombok.
Refactored the source folders.
Updated the changelog with recent changes.
Fixing ticket #68 ... again!
Added support for installing/uninstalling eclipse support from all eclipse locations that lombok is automatically able to find, from the command line without interaction (for mass deployment)

Added more thorough support for detecting we're running as an annotation processor on an unsupported platform, even giving useful suggestions about what you're doing wrong when we detect you're trying to do this on eclipse.

Fixes ticket #53
Post-v0.9.1 release work.
We encountered a strange NPE here. Can't reproduce, nevertheless added null-checks
Removed empty () for annotation without parameters
Improved error reporting
Moved TransformationsUtil to a new package.
Redesigned how lombok runs as a command line app, added the ability to print information about and generate lombok-runtime.jar, fleshed out the 'install' and 'uninstall' command line tools.
The licence file is now also copied into the jar, as well as to the website.
Updated tests for Getter, Setter and Cleanup. Added Synchronized

work in progress.

We need this org-openide-modules.jar too. No direct dependencies, but javac needs some class in it to finish the compile.
Added some tests for @ToString

Added support for SpringSource Tool Suite, which, given that its based on eclipse, was just a matter of updating the installer.

Any future tools that are based on eclipse (and eclipse's JDT) should be very easy to add to the installer now.
Added hailbunny name to upcoming 0.9.2 release.

Running netbeans on a JVM1.5 is not a supported platform for lombok. Instead of an obscure error and no netbeans, you now get netbeans with no lombok, and a GUI warning box explaining what's wrong and how to fix it.

installer fixes:
 - when manually specifying paths via the command line installer, each location would get installed/uninstalled twice, and errors would occur if you provided paths with no known IDEs
 - fixed a problematic earlier checkin regarding STSFinder; now STSFinder looks in all the appropriate spots.
Added -Xlint:unchecked to ant compile.

eclipse project now explicitly defines target JVM as 1.6. Technically it's a mix of 1.5 and 1.6, but that is not expressible in eclipse .classpath files.
Updated eclipse project settings to be more specific (less 'workspace default').
